title: Affine construction of a torsion-controlled coherent algebraization
statement: Let $X$ be an affine Noetherian scheme, $J$ ideal sheaf data, $H$ a coherent module, $N$ a coherent formal module, and $\delta:N\to\widehat H$ a map [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Suppose one positive power $J^t$ annihilates the kernel and cokernel of every component of $\delta$. There exist a coherent module $F$, a map $a:F\to H$ and an isomorphism $\beta:N\simeq\widehat F$, with $\delta=\beta\circ\widehat a$, and a positive $s$ annihilating both the kernel and cokernel of $a$. This assertion concerns a single affine scheme and includes no Zariski descent.

proof.text: Use the canonical affine isomorphism X = Spec Gamma(X) and the coherent and formal affine dictionaries to obtain a finite module P, a finite completed module M-prime, and a map M-prime to completion P. The annihilation equivalence transfers the hypothesis to its limit kernel and cokernel. Identify completion P with its scalar extension.

The Noetherian completion is flat and has the required quotient isomorphism. Formal gluing supplies a module T, a map T to P and a compatible scalar-extension isomorphism, with ideal-power-torsion kernel and cokernel.

For each generator f of the ideal, localization kills the torsion kernel and cokernel. Thus T_f equals the finite module P_f. The completed component is M-prime, also finite. Apply the formal-gluing finiteness criterion to conclude T is finite. Its kernel and cokernel are finite over the Noetherian ring; choose generators and take a common positive maximum of their annihilating exponents.

Sheafify T and the map. Transport the scalar-extension isomorphism through the completion tensor comparison and affine formal equivalence, giving beta and its factorization. The affine ideal-product formula transfers the common exponent to sheaf kernels and cokernels.

A coherent formal module mapping to a completion with ideal power torsion kernel and cokernel algebraizes locally on affine schemes

lean.statement:
theorem torsionControlled_affine_algebraization
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsAffine X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H : CoherentModules X) (N : CoherentFormalModule X J)
    (δ : N ⟶ (completion X J).obj H)
    (htorsion : ∃ t : ℕ, 1 ≤ t ∧ ∀ e : ℕ,
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι t).2
        (kernel (δ.hom.app (op e)))) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι t).2
        (cokernel (δ.hom.app (op e))))) :
    ∃ (F : CoherentModules X) (a : F ⟶ H) (β : N ≅ (completion X J).obj F),
      δ = β.hom ≫ (completion X J).map a ∧
      (∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
          (kernel a.hom)) ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
          (cokernel a.hom)))
